explication: Nomad is a distributed workload orchestrator for containers, applications, batch jobs, and virtual machines. The principal workflow is job submission through the CLI or API, server-side evaluation and scheduling, then allocation execution by client agents and task drivers. The map also includes node resource discovery, device plugins, storage, and ecosystem integrations. Source excerpts are limited, so some documented subsystems use their supported enclosing directories and uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
